"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans invest too little and aim too low in education.",

"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Needed changes will save American children from a lifetime of frustration and limited horizons.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The time for action is now.",
